RU02.en: ALLIED SOLDIER: He is a ghost, sir! Eight deaths in morning... two officers... one shot one kill.
RU02.zh: 盟军士兵：长官，他是个幽灵！一早上八条人命……两名军官……一枪一个。

FR03.en: SNIPER: A good morning's work for a soldier...
FR03.zh: 狙击手：对士兵来说，早上干得不错……

RU03.en: ALLIED SOLDIER: He is not a soldier, sir! He's a killer.
RU03.zh: 盟军士兵：长官，他不是士兵！他是个杀手。

FR04.en: SNIPER: OK, enough talk. As the Yanks say, I´m taking him down.
FR04.zh: 狙击手：好了，别废话。就像美国佬说的，我要把他干掉。

OR01.en: Eliminate the enemy sniper before he finishes off all of your Russian Allies.
OR01.zh: 消灭敌方狙击手，别让他把你的苏军战友全部杀光。

OR02.en: Hurry up with the enemy sniper, there are few Allies left.
OR02.zh: 快解决敌方狙击手，盟军所剩无几了。

TIP1.en: The enemy sniper can shoot further than you. You can also find extra ammunition for your rifle. Try not to waste it.
TIP1.zh: 敌方狙击手的射程比你远。你还能找到额外的步枪弹药。尽量别浪费。
